catalog: uniform recorded K>=2 clusters, conditional on catalog, separately per file; not empirical P(MCU) or independent particle rate
translation: uniform among translations fitting all source offsets in the valid tile; preserve unique coordinates and entire K; no clipping, rotation, wrapping or shape rejection
mapping: contiguous flattened selected words vs round-robin one bit from each nonempty word, both bijections. Same cluster/anchor/clock across mappings; dispersed same K samples payload without replacement using separate location stream
time_model: independent homogeneous Poisson in conditional-branch exposure; equal_expected_flip uses lambda/E[K|recorded K>=2]; source time labels not converted
seed_rule: base + workload_index*1000000 + trial; independent PCG64 clock/catalog/geometry/dispersed streams s,s+1,s+2,s+3; predictor independent
main_count_formula: 6 workloads*3 files*3 mappings*(20 single +10 repeat*2 normalizations)*4 schemes=8640
pilot_contract: first workload, 3 files*3 mappings*(single+repeat equal_event)*4 schemes, one seed; <=100 trials before expansion
statistical_unit: trial seed within each of six fixed holdout workloads; matched mapping/scheme differences; equal-workload mean; not individual branches or source population uncertainty
extra_storage_exposure: selected payload only. Parity/ECC/controller/extra replica cells excluded here and studied in separate E2/E3 full-population experiments
TMR_boundary: only original payload replica0 exposed; this footprint experiment does not establish physical independence of redundant replicas
latency: zero-latency non-spec C++ behavior, not CPU cycles or RTL PPA
